claims.claim_ar: اقتران «حلالًا» بـ«طيبًا» كتكرار تأكيدي لتقوية الوصف والإذن؛ أي: ليس فقط مباحًا بل محبوب وحسن.
claims.claim_en: Pairing 'halal' with 'tayyib' as an emphatic duplication to strengthen the description and permissibility: not merely permitted but wholesome/desirable.

claims.claim_ar: استعمال أداة الحصر (مِمَّا / مِنْ) لتقييد الأكل بما رزقكم الله فقط؛ بيان قصر الإباحة على معين.
claims.claim_en: Use of restriction ('mimma' / 'min') to limit eating to what God has provided only; marking the permissibility as confined to a specific source.
claims.needs_review_reason: Source substring uses 'مِنْهُ' (in Kashshaf) rather than the exact ayah word 'مِمَّا' — same prepositional concept but reviewer should confirm mapping.

claims.claim_ar: أسلوب حكيم يجمع بين الإذن بالأكل والنهي/النصيحة بالورع: توجيه متوازن (أكل مباح + تقوى واجبة).
claims.claim_en: Wise rhetorical style (asloob hakim): combining permission to eat with admonition to fear God — a balanced ethical guidance (permissive instruction followed by moral injunction).
claims.needs_review_reason: Claim is interpretive (stylistic whole-ayah reading). Source substring is a counsel formula; correspondence to classical 'asloob hakim' labeling should be confirmed against targeted classical authors.
